verdicts.reason: Both shrink the Monograph logo to an illegible speck, so the brand is effectively lost, and both stack the price above the title, which flips the original reading order. In A the logo floats arbitrarily between the watch and the text, though the Shop button sits centred on the text block and is grouped with it. In B the logo is pushed into the bottom-left corner beside the watch, and the Shop button is pinned high near the right edge, lined up with the price rather than the block, which leaves its edge margin cramped and the right side unbalanced.
